sentences.text: If you pile dirt across a valley, you have a dam.
But rain fills the lake, water pours over, and the dirt washes away.
So you build a tall concrete wall across the valley.
But now the deep water pushes so hard the thin wall cracks.
So you make it a thick wedge, widest at the bottom.
Its weight holds the water back, and Hoover Dam is 660 feet thick at its base.
But now a storm raises the lake until it spills over the top.
So you add a spillway that carries the extra water past the dam.
Add rocks round the lake, fish, and a lamp.
Congratulations, you have built a dam.
